svg.title: Тяга верхнего блока широким нейтральным хватом — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Wide neutral-grip seated lat pulldown. Use a view slightly above and 40 degrees side-front so distinctive attachment geometry is visible. The pulley has a rigid wide crosspiece with two parallel short handles protruding front-to-back, clearly PERPENDICULAR to the crosspiece, one at each far end. Athlete holds those two handles only, palms facing each other, hands noticeably wider than shoulders. Single cable attached to center of crosspiece and top pulley in both poses. LEFT arms extend upward. RIGHT hands approach shoulder height with elbows driven down and back. Athlete faces machine, thighs fixed under pads, both feet down. Do not use a plain straight bar or close V handle. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
